1. Parse rows R097–R104: extract id, substance(s), ATC3 level 3, signal text, and US label status from each fact line.
2. Load prior ledger state to identify all earlier scanned rows available as cross-reference candidates.
3. Assign each row's "us" field strictly from its given fact line (written / partial / not found / not marketed); never infer or guess.
4. Build each row's "cross" array: earlier rows with the identical signal but a different ATC3 level 3; include id, substance, and us; exclude same-class rows.
5. Output exactly one JSON object per row on its own line in meeting order.
6. Update the state block: COMPLETED, REMAINING, DECISIONS, and CONTEXT cross-entry index (reaction: R### substance ATC3 US-status; …), pruning least-likely-to-recur entries to stay under 3,000 characters.
7. Close the chunk with [STATE_CHECKPOINT] if more rows remain, or [TASK_COMPLETE] if this is the final chunk.
